reviewed: Canonical and public mirror match the declared frozen hash. The production diff is confined to benchTabs; shared benchPreview and the workshop remain unchanged.
The existing six tab IDs, roles, selected state, roving tab index, controlled panel, keyboard handler and selection callback are preserved.

A named section places its heading and introductory paragraph outside the tablist. Each tab references a label containing its original station number, machine name and real Proven status, with its factual observation cue supplied separately through aria-describedby.

The Selected chip is decorative because aria-selected already conveys the state. Hidden inactive chips reserve the same layout space without entering the accessible name or exposing a selected data marker.
All cues describe machine features or actions without promising force reduction, manufacturing mastery, adding state or changing calculations.
Preview size, hover, focus and forced-color rules are scoped to the chooser; shared workshop previews retain their original dimensions and rendering.

Responsive grids, minimum-width handling and text wrapping support narrow layouts. The final forced-colors focus-visible rule retains a distinct outer keyboard-focus ring over the selected-card styling.
New prose uses unique Machine Lab translation keys with English fallbacks. Existing translation keys retain their original fallback text.
No new unit tests were added for this visual change. The relevant existing selection is ten illustrated-navigation cases, twenty-eight accessibility cases and eight translation-hygiene cases.
resolvedDuringReview: Reserved the Selected-chip row on inactive cards to prevent selection-dependent card and grid-row height changes.
Placed a forced-colors focus-visible rule after selected styling so keyboard focus keeps its three-pixel outer outline.
limitations: This review is static. Actual keyboard navigation, rendered accessible descriptions, card stability and responsive appearance require the separately recorded browser checks.
